name: grocery-tracker-android
description: Grocery Tracker Android app by CB, offline-first Capacitor app

scripts.prepare:web: mkdir -p www/vendor && cp node_modules/xlsx/dist/xlsx.full.min.js www/vendor/xlsx.full.min.js && esbuild native-bridge-src.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=www/native-bridge.js
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
